comments.subject: Public Comments
comments.comment: I recently received the Registered Voter pamplet in the mail about the proposed $29 million dollar G.O. Bond for Parks & Trail Systems. I was appalled to receive this in the mail. Why aren't you using this kind of money to support our Police & Fire Depts? They NEED these kinds of funds for their Depts alot more then Parks & Trails!! Please reasse your priorities with our taxes & bonds.

notes: Born-digital forwarded public comment submission. Contact info redacted.
